reviews.text: My cat Poppi enjoyed her stay and was well taken care of for 5 nights! I loved getting the photo updates everyday and being able to check up on her on camera! I would highly recommend if you don’t have anyone to watch your cat when you’re away. The price was very reasonable and I will definitely be using them again for my next trip!

Jennifer & her team are the BEST!  Our 2ragdoll kitties always feel so good after their grooming. Her mobile service is always reliable and very convenient. I highly recommend her for your kitty’s grooming!
Meeow is terrific. So much easier for them to come to me rather than going to an office. Groomers well trained.
My cat enjoyed & it was her first time, ever, as a boarder. Highly recommend.
Good overall experience

“13 years of trusted, loving care”

For 13 years, from 2013 to 2026, Meeow Chicago was our go-to for boarding and grooming whenever we needed someone we could truly trust with Topanga. That kind of long-term relationship says a lot — she was never just “a client’s cat” to them, she was family.

Every time we dropped her off, Topanga went in happy and relaxed, which as any pet owner knows, is not something you can fake or force. She built a genuine bond with Jennifer, Vicky, and the whole team over the years, and it showed in how comfortable she was in their care. The photo updates during her stays meant more than they probably realized — it was a small window into knowing she was safe, content, and looked after by people who actually cared about her wellbeing, not just going through the motions.

The grooming was always exceptional, session after session, year after year, with pricing that never felt like it was creeping up or cutting corners. That consistency over more than a decade is rare.

Topanga passed away recently, and looking back, I’m genuinely grateful that Meeow Chicago was part of her life for as long as it was. They gave us peace of mind during countless trips and stays, and that’s not something we take lightly. I recommend them wholeheartedly to anyone looking for a place that will treat their pet like it matters — because to them, it clearly did.
They took excellent care of my baby !
Thank you so much for letting MIU MIU stay with us! Hopefully when his friends need cat boarding in Ravenswood he will share our info! 😏😎- Thanks again!  …
Fantastic job done on our sweet ragdoll girl by Vicky.  She was patient and kind with her, and she looks like a different cat.  She also was timely and a great communicator.  Highly recommend!

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Meeow Chicago! They have been grooming my 2 Persian cats for 14 years, and I would never even consider going anywhere else. They are consistently kind, professional, knowledgeable, timely, and genuinely caring with both pets and owners.

Persians require very specialized grooming, and the team at Meeow Chicago truly knows what they’re doing. My cats always come home looking beautiful and well cared for, and I completely trust them. Their friendliness and attention to detail have kept me coming back year after year.

I most highly recommend Meeow Chicago to anyone looking for exceptional cat grooming services!
Great place! Cats stay in condos. Very friendly staff, they go above and beyond taking care of my kitty.

The mobile grooming service is fantastic. They took great care of my baby who unfortunately had quite a lot of mats due to coat shedding and me being unwell and unable to keep up with her daily grooming needs. When I brought her back inside it felt like she was trying to say "I feel so much better now!" Picture is from later in the day after the groom. I'm super impressed that they were able to keep her coat looking great despite the volume of matting they needed to cut out. Will for sure book again

We absolutely love Meeow Chicago. They are professional and keep our babies safe, healthy, and feeling loved, regardless of the length of their stay. They provide peace of mind when we are traveling and need someone to be with our cats.

My partner and I unfortunately had a negative experience here and would not recommend this cat hotel to those we know. Our older cat needs to be medicated daily due to chronic illnesses, which also causes him to experience incontinence. My partner confirmed these details with the staff, who said that they would be able to take care of him and keep him and his area clean. We sent along blankets, multiple pee pads that we place on top of those, his favorite toys, etc. When we picked him up, all of his toys and blankets were coated in cat poop from him becoming incontinent and it never being cleaned (photos of a few toys are included here - In general, we also were not expecting them to pack poop cover items back into our bag). This was very upsetting to see, considering we booked him here for several days. In addition, we only received one photo per day, in which we noticed that our cat looked very distressed and abnormally scared. We tried to chalk this up to being a new location for him, but it was out of the norm and knowing what we know now, we’re unsure that he felt safe and taken care of. We’ve now had him back home for a few days, and he has been exhibiting many behaviors of extremely stressed cats, which he has not done after any other experience (and being that he is an older cat, he is well traveled and has stayed in many places, so this is not usual for him). I feel like we trusted the wrong people with our cat, and I wouldn’t be able to confidently tell family or friends to book here.

Smaller details - they do not allow you to see them while they get your cat settled, so you don’t get to see where they end up, and the limited photos they send do not show much of the space. Litter is an extra charge as well, which we assumed would be included since it’s a basic need for all cats and you’re booking a hotel stay for a cat…not a lot of money, just odd.

I boarded my cat Stella here for 8 days while I was traveling and had a very positive experience.

To be honest, I don’t typically use boarding — this was Stella’s first time. She’s very attached to me, and for shorter trips I usually have her stay at home. Because this was a longer trip, I decided to move forward with boarding, and I was definitely a little nervous about how she’d adjust.

The booking process was simple. I submitted the request online and received confirmation within a day or two. At drop-off, I realized I hadn’t brought her litter (I hadn’t caught that they typically ask you to bring your own). They handled it easily — confirmed she uses regular clumping clay litter and provided it for a small additional charge. No issue at all.

The facility is clean, organized, and thoughtfully designed. Each cat has a private suite with visibility into the larger space, which I appreciated. It’s also tucked back from heavy traffic, so drop-off and pickup felt calm and easy.

The staff was friendly and professional. They confirmed her feeding schedule and preferences and sent daily photo updates. Stella looked understandably nervous at first, but by the end of her stay she appeared much more relaxed and comfortable. Seeing how attentive and thoughtful they were with her genuinely eased my initial nervousness.

When my flight arrived early, they were flexible and allowed me to pick her up about an hour ahead of schedule. She came home in good spirits and clearly well cared for.

Overall, I’d absolutely use them again and would recommend them to anyone looking for a clean, communicative boarding option for their cat — especially if you’re hesitant about boarding for the first time.

Cat boarding was great! I WOULD NOT recommend the cat grooming, it’s $160 and they say it includes nail trimming but her nails came back longer than before so I’m sure they didn’t cut them even though “they said they do and cats nails grow back fast”. My vet showed me how to cut her nails and I saw how quickly it took for the to grow and it was obvious the didn’t cut them. Not happy about that especially for the price.
I have used Meeow to care for my elderly cat in excess of six times. They are exceptionally caring and attuned to her particular needs. I can leave her knowing she is in safe hands while I am gone!

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Spa Meeow and the exceptional care they provide.

A special thank you to Vicki, who was absolutely outstanding. Her calm, attentive, and compassionate approach made a world of difference, not only for my cat, but for me as well.

It’s clear that Spa Meeow truly understands feline behavior and prioritizes both comfort and safety. I’m incredibly grateful for their professionalism and genuine care, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to any cat parent looking for thoughtful, high-quality grooming services. 🐾💛

I have had great experiences boarding my two young cats with Meeow Chicago! They send me daily photos and updates and always make sure my kitties are happy and healthy - I couldn’t ask for anything more! Very responsive via text message as well and flexible with my pickup/dropoff needs

We absolutely love the staff at Meoww Chicago. They are fantastic with our Siberian cat, who is not exactly a day at the spa for the team. He can be a bit ornery and they are so great with him. I highly recommend Jennifer and her team
They come directly to our house, which makes it easier on our cats, and they treat them so well.

I am over the moon happy with the service from Meow Chicago! Jennifer was fabulous and my little kitty is so happy to be clean and mat free! I don’t have a car and so having pick up and delivery right in front of my building was so convenient! I will definitely be using this service on a regular basis!
The best groomer service!! Quick, accurate and professional!

My cat loves the groomer. When she brings her in after grooming, the kitty rubs her legs while we are talking
😻

A wonderful experience. Vicky is caring, knowledgable and explains the process.
She is amazing. My one cat will not let anybody cut his nails and she's so patient and does such a great job.
SPAMEEOW! Girlz do their best to have your kitty calm, happy & looking PURrfect! So happy to hear. Thank you for letting us be part of the care team! - Vicky R.
They are the absolute best! Cannot say enough positive things. Lifesaver for me and my cats.

Oh my! I was so nervous about having my cat groomed again as we had less than happy outcomes the first two times he was groomed. And, he's such a baby about strangers and unfamiliar noises. But even with daily brushing, he really needed a professional grooming.
Vicky did an amazing job with Rocky. He was skittish but she says he behaved well. She had to shave a few mats but didn't overdo it, and now his coat looks great. Rocky has been scheduled for a followup session in a few months. Thank you!

We have been using MEEOW for our cats mobile grooming for 10+ years. Vickie is the best and does an amazing job. Our cats love her too! I encourage anyone to use their services for your pets grooming needs.
Thanks Jenna! Can  you let us know how we made your boarding or grooming experience PURRfect? Jenn S.
Friendly, timely and so helpful!

Meeow Chicago has been taking care of our cats for over 10 years.  They really care and love our babies!  I love that they have cameras in their "suites", so when we're on vacation, we can take a peak at our babies during the day when we're thinking of them. They will also periodically, text us photos of the kitties. Sometimes they're even better than the vets.  They will notice things on our cats, bring it to our attention and even give home remedy suggestions for free!  They spoil our kitties with special gifts like bows or catnip filled toys that they love!!!  Jennifer and her crew go above and beyond, always so accommodating, and treat our babies like their own.
This was Hugh’s first stay and we were sad to leave her m. But he did great and had a cozy heated bed that he loved.
Professional grooming brought to your doorstep by true feline lovers. The more I work with them the more I love them. My cat loves showing off after her spa days, too. So convenient. So easy.
They are the best, they’ve been taking care of my cat for years!

We were anxious to board our cats, but they did very well at Meeow. Since we got them the fancier suite, we could watch them using an app and even play with them with a remotely operated laser pointer! The staff were very nice, and our cats adjusted back to being at home very quickly after we picked them up! They also had a first time customer deal that was a big help financially.
Jenifer did a marvelous job of dematting, bathing and overall grooming my senior cat. I highly recommend this company!

My kitty has long fur, and he gets matted very easily. I have him groomed every other month to keep on top of the issues. I don’t own a car, so have the service come to my building is a life saver. I would highly recommend.
They take such great care of my long-haired cat - they’re quick and efficient and make it a pleasant experience for my kitty and me!
We love having our furry cat groomed here quarterly!   They always do a great job and it’s the most convent thing. It eliminates so much shedding in our home and our cat looks beautiful!

There is nothing quite like having a van pull up to your house and then groom your cats! My girls are clean, trimmed, and no issue with transportation! The service was fast and efficient and so easy to book! The girls are back to normal within minutes!
Great service always for my long hair 19 year old kitty. 🐈‍⬛ …

I’ve boarded my cat at Meeow over 6 times now for everything from short three day stays to upwards of 11! Since she’s a rescue, she tends to get a bit anxious whenever we leave her, but she always has a great experience here, even as a senior cat at age 10 now.

Prior to the pandemic, we boarded her a number of times at PetSmart’s Pet Hotel on Elston and looking back, it was not a good fit at all and really didn’t offer our girl much space. Now at Meeow, we couldn’t be happier. Knowing she’s well taken care of, loved, has more than enough room to lounge and play all makes leaving her for a bit easier.

I also so appreciate how communicative the staff at Meeow is! Their quick replies to texts or calls to adjust drop-off or pick-up times and daily update photos on Instagram are just the best. So thankful we have them and I truly think the price is very right!

I was nervous to board my cats for the first time ever due to renovations happening in our home, but we had a great experience at Meeow Chicago! The staff provided me with photo updates everyday, in addition to live video into their suite. They were also very flexible when setting up the booking, as our plans changed and we had to add extra days after making the initial reservation. It was such a relief to know my boys were safe and well taken care of!

We had a wonderful experience for our cat Rustie during her stay. Communication was excellent throughout her stay and we loved receiving photos. We also appreciated the flexibility in adding an additional day for our girl when our flight was delayed and were unable to get there for our original pick up date. We will definitely be back for future stays!
I only trust Meeow Chicago with my girls when we’re out of town. They’re friendly, thorough, kind, and so good to our tiny besties.
Easy and convenient grooming that shows up to where you live. Did not take long to groom my two boys and it’s like they’ve lost a couple lbs in fur!

I don’t have words for this company, they are just absolutely amazing in every way. From scheduling, to showing up at your home, to getting your little friend back, they take 100% pride and care in what they do, by the way I don’t work for them or I didn’t get any free services by them LOL. My pet bubba had surgery over a year ago and I felt very uncomfortable taking him anywhere besides these guys, the girl that comes to groom my pet every time is just amazing, idk what she does to him but when he comes back inside he’s like the most joyful little dude ever, he’s calm and relaxed and he just does his own thing Honestly. This company deserves more than just stars. It is very, very rare nowadays to find a company let alone a person who actually cares about these animals and takes care of them And I can tell you this company does just that. Thank you guys :) if you need someone who will treat your pet like you treat them if not better then you need to get a grooming service by them. Bubba appreciates you guys every time . The moment I put  him in his carrier he starts going crazy. But when he sees his groomer he’s all calm. I don’t get it lol. :) thanks again guys

I have been using Meeow for maybe 15 years
My current babies GIGI and Graci both 3 year old siblings love their spa time. They are rag dolls and have so much hair! They are happy campers and look and smell so beautiful! I have had the same groomer the entire time and she is worth a million bucks! Very thorough and will find something you haven’t seen. So she is always a life saver . I can’t recommend them enough. You will have a beautiful kitty and they will love it!

My cat, Jake, has had a few extended stays with Meeow Chicago this year and last year - every visit has been amazing and I always know he is in good hands when he is staying here. From daily updates and pictures, to having enough toys and time to roam around, he is well taken care of and is always the same energetic cat after I pick him up. I never have to worry about him while I'm away. I highly recommend Meeow Chicago!
I absolutely love this service! It’s so easy for my elderly cat for then to come right out front and it’s so much less stressful for us both!
Highly recommend. They took excellent care of our cats while we were away for a week. The daily updates were nice. Our suite had a web cam so we could check in on them all the time!

This is the best groomer I’ve ever had by far. My cat is usually hard to deal with and people have literally turned us down from coming back bc he’s so difficult. But this groomer does an amazing job and is an angel with my cat. Can’t say enough good things about her; her visits are worth every penny. Highly recommend.
Did a nice job.
Prompt, communicative and great with the cats!

I highly recommend boarding your cat at MEEOW Chicago! We've had our kitty stay at both locations and we've been very happy every time. The staff is friendly and they take great care of her. We always know she is in good hands whenever we drop her off for her stay!

I boarded my 2 cats (ages 5 and 13) at Meeow Chicago for a 10-day stay - highly recommend! The staff are all friendly and informative, drop-off and pick-up were super easy, and I got daily photo updates. Part of why I chose Meeow was that my cats could stay in a room together, and their room had lots spots for climbing and napping. I could rest easy knowing my cats were well cared for and were getting plenty of pets and play time. Thank you Meeow team!
Always happy with the final results when our cat gets groomed.

The Meeow team shows up at our house to bathe our 20lb Siberian every other month.  While a bath is never a cat’s favorite activity, they know how to keep him calm. And in no time he looks and smells good.  Highly recommend the Spa Meeow team - worth every penny and you can’t beat the convenience!

Meeow Chicago's mobile grooming was a wonderful experience. Very easy booking process and the actual grooming process was fast with terrific results. Tiger walked back in the house like a new man! I would definitely use their service again.
Super convent service and they did a great job. My pets were both clean and happy after their visit. Looking forward to using them regularly going forward!
They do such amazing work with my cat.

Very happy that there is a mobile groomers just for cats. They come right outside your home and make the entire experience very easy. Groomers have been friendly, reliable and they do a great job. Jennifer is the best and I can tell she truly cares for my cats.

Jennifer in the Park Ridge/Niles area comes to our home which is super convenient.  Our older cat was having severe skin issues (sores, biting) and the Vet could not figure it out.  After 2 sessions with MEEOW, she was 100% healed and a MUCH HAPPIER kitty.  We highly recommend MEEOW cat grooming.

I highly recommend Spa Meeow to anybody looking to have their cat groomed. My generally nervous long haired cat always comes back to me looking great and not stressed. I also love the convenience of the groomer coming to me.
Great service every time! So convenient that they come to you!
They have been grooming my baby for a year now and I love them! The groomer is so wonderful and truly loves cats which I think is a rarity in groomers!
Our cat seems to like his spa treatment with Meeow Chicago. Their mobile van is convenient and the service is gentle: incredibly valuable for a senior cat who no longer grooms himself very well.
Such great service for my Persian princess. They work efficiently but with care.
My cat looks beautiful!

I’ve used Meeow Chicago for several years and have always been pleased. Getting them into their cat carriers is always a hassle. They hide anywhere they can when they see one.  I wrap them into big towels. Very  professional service and groomers. IIt’s expensive but the time and hassle I save is worth it.

I have been with them for years and wouldn’t trust anyone else with my dog Riley.  We also had three cats, none of which enjoyed the experience but they always smelled so pretty.  The groomer even takes pictures if any of them has a mark or scratch just to make sure I know.  They are the best!

Meeow Chicago and Spa Bark are amazing. I can't imagine what I'd do if I had to take my pets in for grooming as they're both really difficult. Meeow always does an great job and lets me know if there are any areas of concern or issues. They're great with animals and really know their customers. I would highly recommend them.

Meeow Chicago has been taking care of our elderly cat since before the pandemic. They are always kind and gentle with her. She has very long hair, and has stopped cleaning herself, so these bi-monthly groomings really keep her clean. She’s always very happy after her groomings. I highly recommend.Meeow!

I’ve been using Meeow Chicago for mobile grooming for almost 5 years and they have always been great! We’ve been fortunate to have to same groomer over the years and she’s wonderful. I fully trust them with my cat, Kurby, and the mobile aspect is super convenient. Highly recommend!

Meeow Chicago has been grooming our cat Vinnie for over 10 years—first at their Lincoln Park location and now through their mobile service. Vinnie can be a little fussy, but they’ve always handled him with such care and patience. They do an amazing job every time and treat him like their own. We couldn’t ask for better groomers!

Just got my long haired kitties groomed, they look and smell awesome. Vickie did great, they both were matted and looking shaggy, not an easy task given my young kitty is a 20 pounder and my mature girl is 19, arthritic and unable to groom herself well.

We all love grooming coming to us, it’s so much less stressful. Highly recommended!

Absolutely love spa meow! They are flexible with our schedule and treat our animals the best. We get both our cats and dog groomed and have loved working with them! Our old grumpy cat is not the happiest getting groomed but they always do the best job! Would absolutely recommend!

The fabulous folks at Meeow have been taking excellent care of us for years, and I sincerely cannot recommend them enough.  Regular grooming has been incredibly beneficial not only for my feline overlord (who looks fantastic) but also for me, as a key tool in my arsenal against cat allergies.  WE LOVE YOU MEEOW!
The folks at Meeow are unbelievably reliable and friendly. I’ve used them for a couple years now on an every 3 month cadence, and they make my life so easy. Would recommend.

Our notoriously shy and skittish black lab mix dog, Wilma, has been getting groomed by Meeow for probably a year or so now. At first it was nearly impossible to get her into the van. Now she gets pretty close to the van but still needs to be carried in the final few feet. The Meeow Girlz have worked with her calmly and gently, sometimes spending 15 minutes coaxing her closer to the van, giving lots of belly rubs, and making sure she feels comfortable. Wilma comes out fresh and happy. I trust the Meeow Girlz fully, sometimes leaving a key for them to get Wilma out themselves if I'm not home. Highly recommended.
Absolutely love working with Meeow Chicago - great communication, completely trust them with our little fur baby, and the convenience can’t be beat (they drive their grooming truck to you!!!).

Edit/Update: Just had another great service with Meeow. Both  my cats are looking and smelling fantastic and it is all done with minimal stress on the animal. Cannot recommend enough. Original Review: Cats need grooming and this is the company to do it. We have been using them for years. Since the pandemic it has been just the mobile spa which, honestly, i like even better! It's less stressful on the cats because you just walk them a short way to the grooming van and then right back home when they are done (as opposed to a car ride). Highly recommend, book asap though because they are popular and you may have to wait a little for an appointment but it will be worth it!
Another great groom for Xaibe. Thanks Meeow

I’ve used Meeow Chicago’s mobile grooming service regularly for my cat since 2020. They have been amazing every time. They take wonderful care of my cat and I’ve always been happy with the grooming result. The mobile grooming is very convenient and minimizes stress for my cat, who hates to be in the carrier for longer car rides. The team is very responsive and easy to communicate with. Sometimes flexibility in scheduling is required on my side because of their high demand, but it’s worth it!

i love having my cat groomed here!! my cat is elderly and doesn’t clean herself very well. the groomers never* make me feel guilty or bad and are always understanding! they are so fast and communicative and my cat adores her groomer. thank you so so much!!!

I boarded my girls (ages 5 and 8) at Meeow Chicago in Lincoln Park for the first time this past January 2025. It was for 10 days total and was a great experience for both me and my babies. Their apartment had ample toys, climbing opportunities, places to rest, bird TV (which my eldest cat liked to watch), and a bubble window (through which my youngest cat liked to watch other cats and the staff). Their space had a PetCube so I was able to check in on my cats and use the PetCube's interactive laser to play with them. The staff was amazing and sent me daily photos (some are included in this review).

I think the cost of boarding them at Meeow Chicago is well worth the price. I trust the staff and plan to board them again there with my future travels.  I highly recommend their services!
Thank you for your high rated review! It means a lot to us. We love having Suzi stay with us. She is a fun and active kitty!

Was out of town for the holidays and Meeow Chicago took care of my cat. They sent updates frequently so I knew my cat was in good hands. Communication is very important for me especially when it comes to my cat. Top notch communication and facility, would definitely come here again should I be out of town for an extended period.
Had a great experience boarding our two cats here. We needed a safe place for them last minute and Heather could not have been nicer. We got pictures of them and they clearly felt at home.

From the beginning, Meeow Chicago impressed us, from their professional demeanor on the phone and friendly tour of their facility to the checkin process. We were gone for almost two weeks and the daily pictures gave us such peace of mind. …
They boarded our kitty with special medical needs.  They took excellent care of him and send us photos.  We also could see the kitty on petcube.

I'm pleased with my experience at Meeow Chicago. The booking process was easy and every time I asked to make changes to my booking, the team at Meeow was very accommodating and quick to respond to me. My kittens can be very shy in a new …
